# SNDK — Catalysts

## TL;DR

No catalyst within the 10-trading-day swing window as of 2026-05-05. Q4 FY2026 earnings expected ~August 13, 2026 (consensus EPS ~$31.51) — 55+ trading days out. Sell-side consensus is now 29 Buy / 4 Hold / 0 Sell with avg PT ~$1,250 (range $650–$2,000 after post-earnings upgrades); stock at $1,406 is **already above the sell-side average PT**. Seeking Alpha downgraded as "Overheated and Primed to Fall" on 2026-05-05. [source: web_research/SNDK.json analyst_consensus + ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]

## Upcoming events

- **Q4 FY2026 earnings:** Expected ~August 13, 2026 (one source: July 24–August 3 range); consensus EPS $31.51. ~55+ trading days out — outside swing window. [source: web_research/SNDK.json earnings_info, run 20260505_211609]
- **$6B share buyback execution:** Authorized 2026-04-30; ongoing through FY2027. Pace will be disclosed quarterly. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **QLC Stargate datacenter SSD ramp:** Management referenced readiness for coming quarters. No specific date. [source: signals_combined.json swing_catalyst_news SNDK, run 20260505_211609]
- **SK Hynix 321-layer QLC NAND launch H2 2026:** Competitor supply addition — competitive risk event. [source: web_research/SNDK.json key_events, run 20260505_211609]
- **Any incremental hyperscaler contract announcements:** No scheduled date — ad-hoc.

## Recent news synthesis (last 14 days)

- **2026-05-05 — Seeking Alpha downgrade:** "Overheated and Primed to Fall" — overvaluation warning at $1,406 after +361% YTD rally. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-05-05 — SNDK surges +13%** to new 52-week high; up 361.92% YTD. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-05-04 — 24/7 Wall St bearish caution:** "3,314% Rally Leaves Little Room to Run" — 32% downside scenario. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-05-03 — $42B supply agreements confirmed:** Long-term hyperscaler supply agreements alongside Q3 results; zero long-term debt reached; share buyback authorized. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-04-30 — Q3 FY2026 earnings:** Revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $23.41 (beat $14.66 consensus by 61.4%), GAAP GM 78.4%, datacenter revenue $1.47B (+645% YoY), five multi-year hyperscaler contracts, $42B minimum revenue backlog. [source: web_research/SNDK.json earnings_info, run 20260505_211609]

## Insider activity

Aggregate ~$7.3M across 20 Form 4 filings — primarily RSU tax withholdings (CEO David Goeckeler, CTO Alper Ilkbahar) plus one estate-planning gift (director Thomas Caulfield gifted 29,000 shares). No open-market conviction purchases. Sentiment: mildly negative lean but low-signal (typical RSU mechanics). [source: signals_combined.json swing_catalyst_news SNDK, run 20260505_211609]

## Analyst consensus

Rating: **Buy** (29 Buy / 4 Hold / 0 Sell). Post-earnings revisions: Susquehanna $1,000→$2,000; Cantor Fitzgerald →$1,800; Bernstein →$1,700; Fox Advisors →$1,500; Evercore ISI $1,200→$1,400; Raymond James $725→$1,470; Goldman Sachs $700→$1,200; Jefferies Buy $1,400. Avg PT now ~$1,250 (range $650–$2,000). **Stock at $1,406 is above the sell-side average PT** — the upgrade cycle is largely priced. [source: web_research/SNDK.json analyst_consensus, run 20260505_211609]

## Competitor context

Samsung pivoting from DRAM too slowly; considering 20-30% price hikes. SK Hynix pivoting to HBM, leaving enterprise SSD share open. Micron HBM-heavy. YMTC planning 2.5x production expansion — longer-term supply risk. NAND pricing tight post-H2 2025 capacity cuts. [source: web_research/SNDK.json competitor_activity, run 20260505_211609]

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
